items.name: Network Download Graph
items.background: transparent or black with low opacity if available
items.range: Set max to your expected download peak or line speed
items.note: This must be an AIDA64 native Graph item. Do not use static graph PNGs for live history.

items.name: Network Upload Graph
items.background: transparent or black with low opacity if available
items.range: Set max to your expected upload peak or line speed
items.note: Layer on the same area as download if SensorPanel permits overlapping graph items.

items.name: Network Graph Frame
items.note: Optional static transparent frame placed above or below native graph items depending on AIDA64 layering.
